largest.title: Greater Cairo Metro Line No. 4 Phase 1 Project (III)
largest.desc: Project is to respond to increasingtransportation demand and reduce serious traffic congestion by constructing a metroin the south-western part of the Greater Cairo Region, thereby contributing to economic development of the Arab Republic of Egypt.

largest.title: Mombasa Gate Bridge Construction Project (I)
largest.desc: The objective of the Project is to mitigate traffic congestion and facilitate efficient transportation and logistics, by constructing a bridge linking Mombasa Island and South Mainland (Likoni area) and related roads improvement.

largest.title: Development Policy Loan for Universal Health Coverage
largest.desc: The Program aims to support financial protection and quality service delivery under the Universal Health Insurance System in Egypt through policy dialogue and budget support, thereby contributing to attaining Universal Health Coverage and promoting the economic stability of Egypt.

largest.title: Mombasa Special Economic Zone Development Project (I)
largest.desc: This project is to enhance transportation capacity and to stabilize the power supply, by constructing a berth, main road and electric facilities for the Mombasa Special Economic Zone.

largest.title: Greater Cairo Metro Line No.4 Phase 1 Project (II)
largest.desc: To meet traffic demand, mitigate traffic congestion and improve air pollution in the Greater Cairo by constructing a new metro  (approximately 19 km) in the south-west of the Greater Cairo and in the city center of Cairo.

largest.title: The COVID-19 Crisis Response Emergency Support Loan
largest.desc: The objective of this program is to strengthen the health care system, the social security, and financial support for economic activities in Mauritius, in order to mitigate the impact of the COVID-19 pandemic, thereby contributing to economic stabilization and development efforts of the country.

largest.title: Development Policy Loan for Power Sector Reform
largest.desc: By supporting the implementation of reforms to address structural issues in the power sector through financial assistance, the Program aims to strengthen financial sustainability and promote governance reforms in the power sector, and promote renewable energy and energy efficiency for green growth.

largest.title: COVID-19 Response Support Program Loan
largest.desc: To promote strengthening of health care system, expansion of social security system and financial support for micro, small and medium sized enterprises, through providing budget support

largest.title: Eighth Private Sector Assistance Loan under the Joint Initiative Titled EPSA for Africa
largest.desc: Private Sector Development

largest.sector: Electric power transmission and distribution (centralised grids)
largest.title: Lagos and Ogun Power Transmission System Improvement Project
largest.desc: The Project is to enhance the transmission grid wheeling capability and the stability of the electric power supply of the Federal Republic of Nigeria by installing and improving the transmission lines and substation facilities within target area.

largest.title: Arusha-Holili Road Improvement Project
largest.desc: The Objective of this project is to increase the volume and loading capacity o roads, improve traffic safety and lower vehicle operating cost for the target areas. This will respond to the growing traffic volume and hence contribute to economic development and regional integration in East Africa.

largest.title: Development Policy Loan for Universal Health Coverage
largest.desc: To contribute to the achievement towards Universal Health Coverage (UHC) in Morocco by improving delivery and quality of maternal and child health and nutrition services as well as improving health financial protection.

largest.title: Egypt-Japan Education Partnership: Egypt-Japan School Support Program
largest.desc: This Program aims to promote the introduction of the Japanese-style education in Egypt to improve the quality of education and empower youth, thereby contributing to economic stability and development efforts in the country.

largest.title: Development Policy Loan for the Improvement of Learning Environment of Basic Education
largest.desc: The Project aims to improve the learning environment for children by supporting the implementation of priority policies in this area through development policy support, which will lead to the improvement of the basic education system of Morocco.

largest.title: Local Government Infrastructure Support Project
largest.desc: The objective of the Project is to support local government infrastructure projects and expand the investment environment as well as improve the basic infrastructure for local living in both cities and their surrounding areas in Morocco.

largest.sector: Electric power transmission and distribution (centralised grids)
largest.title: Taabo-Kossou-Bouake Power Network Reinforcement Project
largest.desc: The objective of the Project is to increase power supply in the central and northern areas of Cote d'Ivoire as well as neighbor countries by installing and extending the transmission lines, substation facilities and distribution networks between Taabo-Kossou-Bouake.

largest.title: Project for the Construction of Three Intersections in Abidjan
largest.desc: With the objectives of alleviating traffic congestion and improving the convenience and flow of transportation, the project will construct three flyovers at intersections along Boulevard Francois Mitterrand, which passes through Abidjan, the economic center of the country.

largest.sector: Electric power transmission and distribution (centralised grids)
largest.title: Kampala Metropolitan Transmission System Improvement
largest.desc: To improve transmission system

largest.title: Eighth Private Sector Assistance Loan under the Joint Initiative Titled EPSA for Africa
largest.desc: Private Sector Development

largest.title: Project to support economic base development in the Eastern and Southern African region
largest.desc: JICA's loan will be used for infrastructure and industrial development as well as improvement of access to finance in Least Developed Countries (LDCs) of the Eastern and Southern Africa.
